title: bactris maraja var. juruensis
intro: Bactris maraja var. juruensis, commonly known as the Juruena palm, is a species of palm tree native to the Amazon rainforest in Brazil. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Juruena palm include its ability to act as an analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and fever. The bioactive constituents of Bactris maraja var. juruensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
